_meta.purpose: Hand-authored table of detachment-driven ARMY-CONSTRUCTION effects. Muster-time only: nothing in this file describes an in-battle rule. Read by the engine (E21b/E21c/E22b); never generated by any pipeline stage.
_meta.authored_from: The rules as ruled in D204, cross-checked against detachments.json rule_text and the MFM faction files. Deliberately NOT parsed from rule_text: D203 gives three reasons (three fidelity tiers, nine built detachments with no text at all, prose unit names that do not match units.json) and D204 a fourth (the faction-pack paraphrase inverted Shadow Legion's actual constraint).
_meta.key_format: Army|DETACHMENT_NAME_RAW — the same key detachments.json uses.

effect_kinds.battleline: Named units gain the BATTLELINE keyword while this detachment is selected. Changes the unit limit and the display group; does not overwrite unit_type on the record (D204 ruling 2 — effectiveUnitType()).
effect_kinds.forbid: Named units, and/or every unit of the named unit_types, cannot be included while this detachment is selected. except_units are exempt.
effect_kinds.unlock: Units outside the army's own faction may be included, bounded by points_cap.
effect_kinds.warlord: Detachment-scoped Warlord constraint. mode is 'cannot_be' or 'must_be_if_present'. Distinct from the per-unit must_be_warlord / cannot_be_warlord fields on units.json, which are unconditional and army-wide.

target_shapes.units: Explicit unit_name list. Must resolve in that army's resolved pool (own block plus the generic Adeptus Astartes block for chapter subfactions).
target_shapes.unit_types: unit_type values. Preferred over naming every member, so a unit added later is caught rather than silently missed.
target_shapes.allied_group: Matches the allied_group field B61 put on units.json records.
target_shapes.keyword: A faction keyword naming a unit set that the app cannot yet name as data. Only ever appears with enforced: false.

_meta.points_cap: Keyed by the army points total for the battle size — 1000 Incursion, 2000 Strike Force, 3000 Onslaught. Matches how the engine reads POINTS_CAP. Onslaught is carried even though the app does not yet offer it, so a future session adding it needs no re-derivation.
_meta.enforced: Whether every piece of data this effect needs already exists in the app, so the engine can enforce it once wired. It is NOT a claim that the engine enforces it today. enforced: false is load-bearing (D203): a known gap recorded in data and counted by an assertion, rather than made invisible by omission.

not_in_this_file.chapter_exclusivity: 25 built detachments carry it. resolveUnits() composes a chapter army as the generic pool plus that chapter's own units, so no foreign-chapter unit is ever reachable — D0 satisfied by construction. Policed by a structural assertion in E21b, not by a row here (D203).
not_in_this_file.belakor_warlord: Chaos Daemons | SHADOW LEGION requires Be'Lakor to be the Warlord if he is included. Be'Lakor's units.json record already carries must_be_warlord: true from his Supreme Commander ability, which is unconditional and therefore strictly stronger than the detachment's conditional version. A row here would be a second source for one rule that could drift out of step with the first. Omitted deliberately and policed by assertion E21a-6 (D209).

units: Death Company Marines with Bolt Rifles

effects.source: Both units are Blood Angels Infantry in units.json and both are named in the detachment's KEYWORDS clause.
Outrider Squad is a Mounted unit in the generic Adeptus Astartes block, reachable by Dark Angels through resolveUnits(). Its unit_type stays Mounted; the elevation is applied by effectiveUnitType().
Poxwalkers is Death Guard Infantry in units.json and is the sole unit named in the detachment's KEYWORDS clause.
B61 tagged the six Death Guard Plague Legions units with allied_group. Without this detachment selected they must not be offered at all — that is the live D0 violation D204 found, and E22b closes it.

No PLAGUE LEGIONS model can be the Warlord. Detachment-scoped, so it cannot live as cannot_be_warlord on the unit records — those six units are legal Warlords in a Chaos Daemons army, where they are native rather than allied.
Traitor Guardsmen Squad is Chaos Space Marines Infantry in units.json and is the sole unit named in the detachment's KEYWORDS clause.

units: Daemon Prince of Chaos with Wings

effects.source: D204 ruling 1. The two Daemon Princes are named explicitly because their unit_type is Character, not Epic Hero, so the type rule alone would miss them. The remaining twelve Chaos Daemons Epic Heroes are caught by type rather than by name so that a later addition to the pool is forbidden automatically.

effects.unenforced_reason: The unlocked set is an explicit list of Chaos Space Marines datasheets, and Chaos Space Marines is not built yet. Nothing is currently reachable through this effect, so the gap costs no legality today; it becomes enforceable the session CSM lands. Recorded rather than omitted so it is countable (D203).
effects.source: D204 ruling 3 — MFM_Chaos_Daemons_v1_0.txt carries no HERETIC ASTARTES section; the set is named inside the detachment's own rule text.

effects.unenforced_reason: Turn A (which tags the six Scintillating Legions carrier units — Kairos Fateweaver, Lord of Change, Flamers, Screamers, Pink Horrors, Blue Horrors — with allied_group on their TS-priced units.json records) has not shipped yet (E24, D245). Nothing is currently reachable through this effect, so the gap costs no legality today; enforce it the session turn A lands.
effects.source: Wahapedia Detachment_abilities.csv id 000010196 'Infernal Pacts', keyed to detachment id 000001062 (Changehost of Deceit). Points caps mirror Death Guard's Plague Legions clause under Tallyband Summoners exactly (500/1000/1500 by battle size).
